topic: Marketing: website traffic but no orders, store conversion (handbags)
lines: Bees hazaar rupay ke ads se hazaar log aaye, sirf do ne khareeda.
Kyunki page dheere khulta hai, aur order button dhoondna padta hai.
Customer bharosa dekhta hai: reviews, delivery details, WhatsApp par baat.
Hum store tez banate hain, aur order sirf do tap mein.
Reviews, return policy aur WhatsApp button, pehli screen par.
Wahi traffic, wahi kharch, par orders zyada ho sakte hain.
Yeh reel kisi seller ko bhejein.
Store tez karwana hai? Comment STORE.
